title: Neon Pigscene
description: Replaces Pigscene  with a glowing rainbow circle
body:
🌈 Rainbow Pigscene

This resource pack replaces the original "Pigscene" painting.

**What it changes:**
- Changes the file: `assets/minecraft/textures/painting/pigscene.png`

**What it becomes:**
Replaced with a beautiful glowing rainbow colorful circle / orb.
